excerpts.content:
Hi everyone.  I am looking for a beacon api ednpoint which let me retrieve partial data from the beacon state without fetching the full beacon state.
I am intersted in getting data on withdrawals
```
    // Withdrawals
    nextWithdrawalIndex
    nextWithdrawalValidatorIndex
```
Is there any API endpoint which I can call for these except `/eth/v2/debug/beacon/states/{state_id}`
